zh-CN.title: 保存这份报告
zh-CN.body: 把本次自我报告结果留存下来，方便之后回看同一套分数、证据和行动建议。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 保存不会改变报告结论，也不把本次结果变成能力评定或诊断记录。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费保存；只用于个人回看和复测对照。

en.title: Save this report
en.body: Keep this self-report result so you can return to the same scores, evidence, and action notes later.
en.do_not_overread: Saving does not change the report and does not turn it into an ability rating or diagnostic record.
en.microcopy: Free save action; for personal review and retest comparison only.

meta.risk_notes: Free retention action; no diagnostic, ability, hiring, or commerce-gate implication.

zh-CN.title: 发送回看链接
zh-CN.body: 把报告入口发送到邮箱，适合在更安静的时间继续阅读，而不是匆忙记住所有结论。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 邮件回看只是访问方式，不代表报告经过人工审核或专业认证。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费回看；不会新增或改变解释。

en.title: Email a revisit link
en.body: Send yourself a link so you can read the report again in a calmer moment instead of trying to remember every point now.
en.do_not_overread: Email revisit is only an access method; it does not mean the report has been human-reviewed or certified.
en.microcopy: Free revisit action; no new interpretation is added.

meta.risk_notes: Free revisit action; no certification, review, or commerce-gate implication.

zh-CN.title: 导出个人 PDF
zh-CN.body: 保存一份静态版本，便于个人复盘、做笔记，或和之后的复测结果放在一起看。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: PDF 只是报告副本，不适合作为临床、招聘、绩效或能力证明材料。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费导出；仅用于个人记录。

en.title: Export a personal PDF
en.body: Keep a static copy for personal reflection, notes, or later comparison with a retest.
en.do_not_overread: The PDF is only a copy of the report; it is not suitable as clinical, hiring, performance, or ability evidence.
en.microcopy: Free export; for personal records only.

meta.risk_notes: Free export action; explicitly not clinical, hiring, performance, or ability evidence.

zh-CN.title: 生成轻量分享卡
zh-CN.body: 如果你愿意分享，只展示概括性的自我报告主题，不展示敏感分数或内部标签。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 分享卡不是完整报告，也不适合用来评价、筛选或比较他人。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费生成；默认保护分数和内部标签。

en.title: Create a light share card
en.body: If you choose to share, show only a broad self-report theme, not sensitive scores or internal tags.
en.do_not_overread: A share card is not the full report and should not be used to judge, screen, or compare people.
en.microcopy: Free card; scores and internal tags stay hidden by default.

meta.risk_notes: Free sharing action; must not expose sensitive scores, raw tags, or imply people comparison.

zh-CN.title: 设置复测提醒
zh-CN.body: 在经历一段真实生活或工作变化后，再看自我感知是否有变化。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 复测变化可能来自状态、情境、理解方式或作答质量变化，不等于能力变好或变差。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费提醒；复测用于观察变化，不用于能力排名。

en.title: Set a retest reminder
en.body: After some real-life or work changes, revisit whether your self-perception has shifted.
en.do_not_overread: A retest change may reflect mood, context, interpretation, or response quality; it is not proof that ability improved or declined.
en.microcopy: Free reminder; retesting is for reflection, not ability ranking.

meta.risk_notes: Free reminder action; retest changes must not be framed as ability gain/loss.

zh-CN.title: 继续相关测试
zh-CN.body: 用其他测评补充人格、兴趣和工作方式背景，但不要把不同测评混成一个总分。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 相关测试只能提供相邻视角，不能验证或否定这份 EQ 自我报告。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费继续；不同测评保持各自边界。

en.title: Explore related tests
en.body: Add personality, interest, or workstyle context without blending different assessments into one total score.
en.do_not_overread: Related tests add adjacent context; they do not prove or disprove this EQ self-report.
en.microcopy: Free next step; each assessment keeps its own boundary.

meta.risk_notes: Free related-test routing; no merged score, validation claim, or commerce funnel implication.

zh-CN.title: 向结果助手提问
zh-CN.body: 围绕报告里已经生成的内容问一个具体问题，例如某个场景、行动建议或置信度说明。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 助手只能解释已生成的报告资产，不能改分数、改结论、诊断你，或开放未上线模块。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费辅助阅读；报告权威仍以后端结果为准。

en.title: Ask the result assistant
en.body: Ask about one specific part of the generated report, such as a scene, action note, or confidence explanation.
en.do_not_overread: The assistant can only explain generated report assets; it cannot change scores, rewrite conclusions, diagnose you, or open unavailable modules.
en.microcopy: Free reading support; the backend report remains authoritative.

meta.risk_notes: Free read-only assistant entry; no mutation, diagnosis, unavailable SJT, or authority override.

zh-CN.title: 补充大五人格视角
zh-CN.body: 用大五人格理解更稳定的人格倾向背景，例如情绪反应、合作取向和自我管理风格。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 大五不能替代 EQ 报告，也不能把你的情绪与关系模式简化成一个人格标签。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费补充；只作为相邻背景。

en.title: Add a Big Five lens
en.body: Use Big Five to understand broader trait context, such as emotional reactivity, cooperation style, and self-management tendencies.
en.do_not_overread: Big Five does not replace the EQ report and should not reduce your emotional-relational pattern to one trait label.
en.microcopy: Free add-on context; adjacent lens only.

meta.risk_notes: Free related-test action; no trait reduction or validation claim.

zh-CN.title: 补充 MBTI 表达视角
zh-CN.body: 用 MBTI 观察偏好的表达、能量使用和信息处理方式，与 EQ 报告分开理解。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: MBTI 不是 EQ 证据，也不能说明你一定会如何处理情绪或关系。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费补充；不要合并成单一类型结论。

en.title: Add an MBTI expression lens
en.body: Use MBTI to reflect on preferred expression, energy use, and information processing, separately from the EQ report.
en.do_not_overread: MBTI is not EQ evidence and does not prove how you will handle emotions or relationships.
en.microcopy: Free add-on context; do not merge it into one type conclusion.

meta.risk_notes: Free related-test action; no EQ validation or deterministic behavior claim.

zh-CN.title: 补充 RIASEC 兴趣视角
zh-CN.body: 用兴趣信号思考你想探索的工作活动和环境，再和 EQ 的职业环境变量分开比较。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: RIASEC 不能决定你适合或不适合某个职业，也不能替代岗位、组织和文化验证。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费补充；只帮助提出探索问题。

en.title: Add a RIASEC interest lens
en.body: Use interest signals to think about work activities and environments you may want to explore, then compare them separately with EQ environment variables.
en.do_not_overread: RIASEC does not decide whether a job is suitable for you and cannot replace role, organization, or culture checks.
en.microcopy: Free add-on context; use it to form exploration questions.

meta.risk_notes: Free related-test action; no job suitability, hiring, or career prediction claim.

zh-CN.title: 补充九型动机视角
zh-CN.body: 用动机和防御模式视角，补充理解压力下的自我叙事和关系反应。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 九型不能诊断动机，也不能证明你在冲突或亲密关系中一定会怎样。
zh-CN.microcopy: 免费补充；只作为反思线索。

en.title: Add an Enneagram motivation lens
en.body: Use motivation and defense-pattern language as an adjacent way to reflect on stress narratives and relationship responses.
en.do_not_overread: Enneagram does not diagnose motivation and cannot prove how you will act in conflict or close relationships.
en.microcopy: Free add-on context; reflection cue only.

meta.risk_notes: Free related-test action; no diagnostic or deterministic relationship claim.

zh-CN.title: 未来情境模块说明
zh-CN.body: EQ-SJT 16 题仍是 planned/unavailable。它未来只会补充情境选择视角，不会把当前 EQ-60 改成能力测验。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 当前没有可点击入口，也没有情境题结果；请不要把它理解为已开放的真实能力测验。
zh-CN.microcopy: 暂未开放；不提供测试入口。

en.title: Future scenario module note
en.body: EQ-SJT 16 remains planned and unavailable. If added later, it will only add a scenario-choice lens; it will not turn EQ-60 into an ability test.
en.do_not_overread: There is no clickable entry and no scenario result yet; do not treat it as an available true-ability measure.
en.microcopy: Unavailable for now; no test entry is provided.

meta.risk_notes: Planned-only SJT note; no availability, ability-test, MSCEIT-like, or take-entry implication.
